description.value: Participants experienced tenderness, anguish and neutral emotional states while receiving real-time fMRI neurofeedback through a virtual environment and musical stimuli.
Tenderness trials with tenderness music excerpts and an orange virtual-environment color.
Anguish trials with eerie, distorted music excerpts and a purple virtual-environment color.
Neutral trials with no background music and a normal-colored virtual landscape.

spans.text: The virtual environment was prepared to alternate between different trial types: neutral (30″), tenderness (46″) and anguish (46″).

stimuli.value: musical excerpts and a virtual environment

spans.text: The rtfMRI-NFB software (FRIEND Engine) was adapted to provide a virtual environment as brain computer interface (BCI) and musical excerpts to induce two emotions (tenderness and anguish), aided by participants' preferred personalized strategies to maximize the intensity of these emotions.
During neutral rtfMRI-NFB trials, participants were not required to change the color of the virtual environment and this remained at baseline color.

presentation_software.value: Unity 3D asset and FRIEND Engine Framework v0.5; operating system not reported.

spans.text: The FRIEND Engine Framework system ( 21 ) was enhanced and adapted for this aim.

instructions.value: Participants were instructed to experience tenderness or anguish as intensely as possible during the respective trials and to increase the emotion intensity to turn the virtual environment as orange as possible for tenderness or as purple as possible for anguish. During neutral trials they were not required to change the virtual environment color.
